title: Ed Anger tabloid column: "Congress blows $120 million trying to talk to extraterrestrials"
description: Tabloid newspaper clipping of the "MY AMERICA By ED ANGER" column headlined "Congress blows $120 million trying to talk to extraterrestrials ... & TAXPAYERS ARE FOOTING THE BILL," with "Weekly World News" printed in the side margin. The main image shows an E.T.-like alien figure holding a telephone handset alongside an inset clipping headlined "Scientist wants to talk to E.T."; the caption says the column calls it "a waste of taxpayers' hard-earned money trying to contact space aliens." A small portrait is captioned "SCIENTIFIC QUEENPIN: Dr. Ruth Jones Hamer," and the column criticizes funding for the Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence; a handwritten number appears at top.
